newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Nizhny Novgorod to issue Eurobond in summer.
newsitem.headline: Russia Nizhny Novgorod to issue Eurobond in summer.

text.p: Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region has decided to make its debut Eurobond issue this summer, the deputy chief executive of the Regional Agency for Investment Promotion said on Monday.
Previously, regional authorities had said the issue was planned for April or May.
But Andrei Bespalov told Reuters the region was waiting for the results of the May U.S. Federal Reserve meeting and did not want to coincide with a Russian sovereign Eurobond issue, likely in June.
"It will definetely not happen in May. If we expect a sovereign issue in June, it is dangerous to follow it closely," Bespalov said. "The borrowing will be more expensive."
Last week, Russia's Deputy Finance Minister Oleg Vyugin said the next Eurobond issue would be in May followed by at least one more issue in autumn.
But market sources in London have said a Russian issue is unlikely before June.
U.S. Federal Open Market Committee will meet on May 20. Analysts and bankers have forecast the Fed will raise its funds rate again.
Bespalov said a significant rate hike might prompt Nizhny Novgorod to change the Eurobond denomination, currently planned in dollars.
Nizhny Novgorod region plans to issue up to $100 million in three to five-year Eurobonds.
